struct Messages
  virtual ObserveDeliveryResult observe_delivery(const MessageRef& reference, const std::string& pairing_epoch)
  virtual InboxPage inboxes_for_person(const std::string& cursor)
  virtual ChatInboxChange inbox_open_chat(const std::string& instance, const std::string& source_context, const std::string& status, const ChatBinding& binding)
  virtual SendResult send_chat(const std::string& instance, const std::string& source_context, const ChatSendRequest& request)
  virtual PrepareResult prepare(const std::string& instance, const std::string& source_context, const PrepareRequest& request)
  virtual SendResult reply(const std::string& instance, const std::string& source_context, const std::string& message_id, const std::string& body)
  virtual InboxChange inbox_open(const std::string& instance, const std::string& context, const std::string& status)
  virtual InboxPage inboxes_list(const InboxQuery& query)
  virtual SendResult send(const std::string& instance, const std::string& source_context, const SendRequest& request)
  virtual Page wait(const std::string& instance, const std::string& context, const View& view, const std::string& after, const std::string& revision, const std::int64_t& wait_ms)
  virtual Page read_for_person(const std::string& message_id)
  virtual StopResult stop_for_person(const std::string& message_id)
  virtual TurnWakeResult turn_wake(const std::string& instance, const std::string& source_context, const std::string& wake)
template<class Transport>struct MessagesClient : Messages
  Transport& transport_
  ObserveDeliveryResult observe_delivery(const MessageRef& reference, const std::string& pairing_epoch) override
  InboxPage inboxes_for_person(const std::string& cursor) override
  ChatInboxChange inbox_open_chat(const std::string& instance, const std::string& source_context, const std::string& status, const ChatBinding& binding) override
  SendResult send_chat(const std::string& instance, const std::string& source_context, const ChatSendRequest& request) override
  PrepareResult prepare(const std::string& instance, const std::string& source_context, const PrepareRequest& request) override
  SendResult reply(const std::string& instance, const std::string& source_context, const std::string& message_id, const std::string& body) override
  InboxChange inbox_open(const std::string& instance, const std::string& context, const std::string& status) override
  InboxPage inboxes_list(const InboxQuery& query) override
  SendResult send(const std::string& instance, const std::string& source_context, const SendRequest& request) override
  Page wait(const std::string& instance, const std::string& context, const View& view, const std::string& after, const std::string& revision, const std::int64_t& wait_ms) override
  Page read_for_person(const std::string& message_id) override
  StopResult stop_for_person(const std::string& message_id) override
  TurnWakeResult turn_wake(const std::string& instance, const std::string& source_context, const std::string& wake) override
